en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town in a hilly rural landscape, photographed from a slope above the settlement. In the foreground are fenced gardens, fields, and a few detached houses. A curving road leads toward the town. The middle ground shows dense clusters of traditional gabled houses and several factory chimneys. Two large church buildings with tall towers and baroque-style spires dominate the skyline. Beyond the town lie gently rolling, mostly treeless fields. There is no visible printed caption or handwritten text on the image side.
